html:
Luanda is the capital of Angola, founded by the Portuguese in 1576 as São Paulo da Assunção de Loanda. For nearly three centuries it was the base of Portuguese Angola and one of the biggest slave ports in the world.

Portugal first worked through the kingdom of Kongo, to the north. In 1576 Paulo Dias de Novais landed with soldiers and settlers to build a colony of his own, and pushed inland against Ndongo. Wars with Ndongo and its queen Nzinga fed the trade in captives. From Luanda more Africans were shipped across the Atlantic than from almost any other port, most of them to Brazil.

The Dutch held the town from 1641 to 1648, until a fleet from Brazil took it back. After the slave trade ended, Luanda stayed the colonial capital, and it grew fast in the 20th century. Today it has millions of people and is one of the largest Portuguese-speaking cities in the world.
sum: Luanda is the capital of Angola, founded by the Portuguese in 1576 as São Paulo da Assunção de Loanda. For nearly three centuries it was the base of Portuguese Angola and one of the biggest slave ports in the world.
